professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 2 years, 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, language, and sensory processing domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both strengths, such as emerging developmental skills and learning potential, as well as areas requiring targeted intervention, particularly in fine motor coordination, attention and focus, communication skills, and behavioral regulation. These areas of need significantly impact Sabrina's functional performance in daily activities, including play, learning, and social interaction. Based on the assessment findings, occupational therapy services are recommended to address these specific needs and facilitate developmental progression. A collaborative, family-centered approach involving occupational therapy, speech therapy, and behavioral interventions will be beneficial in delivering comprehensive support. Regular monitoring and reassessment will be critical to track Sabrina's progress, adjust intervention strategies, and ensure continuous engagement with developmental goals. Family involvement and education are paramount in reinforcing therapeutic strategies at home and achieving optimal outcomes through consistent engagement with therapy activities.
